title: Strangler fig pattern
description: Documented public migration pattern (Martin Fowler (pattern)) for the Legacy Modernization Engine capability area.
body:
Strangler fig pattern is a documented migration pattern from Martin Fowler (pattern). Fowler's pattern for incrementally replacing legacy systems by routing traffic through new services — the standard modernization strategy.

How it works: It works by comparing the old and new column sets, reporting added, removed, and type-changed fields, and flagging whether the migration is safe.

Documented uses of this capability area include greenfield application generation, legacy system modernization, API platform design, and continuous testing pipelines.
